'''''Victorious Reign''''' was the name of a [[Painting/Legends|poster]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] produced ''Victorious Reign'' during that [[Time/Legends|time]] for [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] purposes. The poster's foreground depicted an Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] raising [[Gender/Legends|his]] left [[Limb/Legends|arm]] while his right arm lay at his side. The background featured two slightly different shades of [[Color/Legends|red]] alternating in a vertical stripe pattern with a big, black lightning symbol in the middle. Along the top of the poster was silver-colored [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] lettering, the [[Writing/Legends|alphabet]] of [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], which read "VICTORIOUS REIGN."

==Description==
''Victorious Reign'', a [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] [[Painting/Legends|poster]], portrayed an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] in the foreground, raising [[Gender/Legends|his]] left [[Limb/Legends|arm]] in victory while his right arm lay at his side. The [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] carried an [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]] in his right hand. The background featured two slightly different shades of [[Color/Legends|red]] alternating in a vertical stripe pattern with a large, dark lightning symbol in the center. Silver lettering along the top of the poster read "VICTORIOUS REIGN" in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]], the [[Writing/Legends|alphabet]] of [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]].<ref name="SWG" />

==History==
The poster was one of many pieces of propaganda produced by the Galactic Empire during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy-wide]] conflict between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. ''Victorious Reign'' was produced sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which took place in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Victorious Reign'' was a poster that appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SWG" /> It appeared briefly on the game's Test Center, a game server that was separate from the main collection of "live" game servers used by the developers to test new content while still in development.<ref name="ZAM">{{WebCite|url=http://www.zam.com/forum.html?forum=22&mid=1101973029677415412&h=50|text=Over-reaction?|date=2004-12-02|work=Allakhazam|archivedate=20130801205402}}</ref>

The reason the poster never reached the live servers is unknown, but a popular theory among players was that it was reminiscent of various racist propaganda in the real world. While the poster never made it to the live servers, copies were still present on the Test Center for a time and were usually destroyed by Sony employees if discovered.<ref name="ZAM" /><ref name="ZAM2">{{WebCite|url=http://swg.allakhazam.com/db/abilities.html?swgability=3260|text=Victorious Reign|date=2004-12-03|work=Allakhazam|archivedate=20041217155926}}</ref><ref name="Stormtrooper">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Itemsloot&message.id=18130.html|text=Tell me I'm not insane Nazi Stormtrooper painting}} {{C|"username/password: swganh"}}</ref> Additionally, since the poster never made it off the game's test center, its [[canon]] status is ambiguous.
